The '''Incorporation Islands''' was a district of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] which was series of islands occupied by the largest and most prosperous business entities.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" /> Most of this sector was wholly owned and controlled by different [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning enterprises. In the time of the [[Galactic War]], these areas responded with hostility to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Corellia|takeover]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It became the site of some of the fiercest fighting on Corellia as the highly-paid corporate security forces and their armies of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] fought against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] invasion forces.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Incorporation Islands}}</ref>
